text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ohh...
Gold City really is gorgeous after all.
I totally got captivated.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Still, her running is incredible too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I kind of took her lightly thinking she was just a pretty face,
but she can seriously run...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Man, this year's Classic races have such an interesting
lineup. I can't wait for the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's our City, alright!
Off to a great start.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Just kiddin'... Why the heck am I
watchin' from a place like this anyway?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I mean...
I heard them say, "Her running's amazing too."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I wasn't wrong after all.
Changing my path back then, I mean...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I might have let some people down, but
thanks to that, people are paying attention to my running now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: If she runs like this, she can do it, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Not just as a pretty doll,
people will see the real me...!
choice_data_list: Let's ride this momentum and take the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Once I become a Derby Umamusume,
I'll be at the top of our generation.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: There's not much time left, but we'll train you thoroughly!
There's not much time left, but I'll train you thoroughly!
